exposure: two or more previous cesarean sections
Number of previous cesarean sections (2, 3, 4 or more)
cohort: 551 women with single term pregnancy after two or more cesarean deliveries
finding: The rate of maternal complications was significantly lower in women with three previous cesarean sections compared to those with four or more, and elective cesarean delivery was associated with fewer complications than emergency cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean delivery was associated with a higher rate of maternal complications compared to elective cesarean delivery.
